title: Extension of dependent coverage.
bodyText: An individual policy of accident and health or sickness insurance and a health insurer offering individual accident and health or sickness insurance coverage that provides dependent coverage of children shall continue to make that coverage available for an adult child until the child turns twenty-six years of age. Nothing in this section shall require a policy or health insurer to make coverage available for a child of a child receiving dependent coverage.
bodyHtml: [§431:10A-141]  Extension of dependent coverage.  An individual policy of accident and health or sickness insurance and a health insurer offering individual accident and health or sickness insurance coverage that provides dependent coverage of children shall continue to make that coverage available for an adult child until the child turns twenty-six years of age.  Nothing in this section shall require a policy or health insurer to make coverage available for a child of a child receiving dependent coverage. [L 2018, c 111, pt of §2]
